services.desc: With all of our amenities, you may forget you’re at a campground. To make your stay more enjoyable, we’ve taken camping in Virginia Beach to the next level. Our park is loaded with comforts and conveniences for everyone in your group - including the family pet! Looking for a tasty snack? Head over to our snack bar for sandwiches, snacks, ice cream & more. Open seasonally. Ask the office for hours. Head to our parking lot 2 miles north of the campground at Pacific Avenue & Norfolk Ave (9th St.). It‘s one block from the boardwalk and has space for 155 passenger vehicles.
